property_summary: For any admissible actor and amount, two consecutive complete withdraw calls by the same actor must both succeed (the reentrancy lock is always released after each withdraw); the mutant leaves the lock set forever, so the second withdraw always reverts.
change_summary: Delete the post-statement reset of the lock so after the first withdraw the lock stays true and all subsequent withdraw calls revert, leaving their balances nonzero.
